flows.title: An editor creates a variant definition by hand
flows.desiredExperience: Creating a definition feels like filling in a **short form**. The editor never has to know where the data is stored.

phases.title: Find the tool
phases.description: Reach the Variants tool and see what exists.

phases.title: Define
phases.description: Describe who the definition is for.

flows.trigger: A campaign needs a **new audience** that no definition covers yet.

steps.text: The editor opens the **Variants** tool and reads the list of definitions.
The editor chooses **New variant definition** and gives it a *title*.
The editor adds the **first condition**: a key and a value.
The new definition appears in the list with **0 documents**.

flows.success: The definition exists and can be used for variant documents.
flows.failure: The editor cannot tell which **keys** are allowed.

painPoints.text: Free-text keys let a typo create a **new dimension**.
painPoints.quote: “I typed audiance and nothing told me.” (editor, workshop)
